cards.front: What is a baseline in visual testing?
cards.back: An approved image of the page or element. Later runs are compared with it, and it is committed to the repository.
It only saves an image and never compares it. `expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()` compares with a baseline and can fail.

cards.front: What happens the first time `toHaveScreenshot()` runs?
cards.back: Playwright writes the baseline and fails the test, so you review the image before committing it.

cards.front: What makes up a default baseline file name?
cards.back: The name you passed, the project name and the platform, as in `pricing-chromium-darwin.png`.

cards.front: Which images does a failed comparison produce?
cards.back: `-expected.png`, `-actual.png` and `-diff.png`, saved in `test-results/` and shown in the HTML report.
`-u` means `changed`, so it rewrites only baselines that differ. `all` also rewrites ones that still match.
The perceived color difference at which one pixel counts as changed, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.2.

cards.front: What if you set both `maxDiffPixels` and `maxDiffPixelRatio`?
Can `maxDiffPixels` allow a screenshot with a different size?
cards.back: No. A different image size fails however loose the limits are.
It covers matching elements with a solid box, pink `#FF00FF` by default. Set `maskColor` to change it.

cards.front: What happens if a `mask` locator matches nothing?
cards.back: Nothing is masked and no error is raised, so assert that the element is visible first.

cards.front: How does `toHaveScreenshot()` treat animations by default?
cards.back: `animations` is `'disabled'`. Finite animations jump to their end state and infinite ones return to their start.

cards.front: What does "Failed to take two consecutive stable screenshots" mean?
cards.back: The page kept changing until the timeout. Freeze the changing content with `page.clock` or mask it.
It applies a stylesheet only while the screenshot is taken, for example to hide a chat widget.
In the same environment that checks them, such as the CI job or the same Playwright Docker image.
